briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Michigan Regulators Crack Down on Bad Actors as November Ballots Could Expand Access
briefs.top: Michigan's CRA keeps tightening enforcement — pulling Muha Meds Ypsilanti's license over influencer vape giveaways — even as two cities head to the Nov. 3 ballot on allowing more dispensaries and a new storefront opens near the Ohio border. Nationally, New York cannabis sales are on pace for a record year, a Colorado vape recall raises safety flags, and psychedelics keep advancing on two fronts: a fresh MAPS training partnership and a second positive Phase 3 readout for Definium's LSD anxiety drug.

local.text: CRA pulls Muha Meds Ypsilanti's license, fines it $251,250 — Regulators found the retailer funneled hundreds of vape cartridges to two social-media influencers by splitting orders to dodge oversale limits, among seven rule violations in a final order signed Oct. 1.
Menominee voters to decide on more dispensaries Nov. 3 — A judge cleared a ballot measure that would raise the city's marijuana retailer cap from 9 to 13 licenses.

Bad Axe to vote on ending its marijuana ban — The city council unanimously sent a citizen-initiated measure to the Nov. 3 ballot that would repeal its 2019 prohibition and allow up to two marijuana businesses.
High Profile Cannabis opens new storefront minutes from Toledo — The retailer's latest Michigan location aims to capture Ohio border traffic near the state line.

Michigan brands roll out Halloween drops — Armada Cannabis Co.'s fresh-pressed apple cider (20mg THC) and seasonal 'Phillip Noir' blend lead a crop of fall-themed releases from Michigan edibles makers.

national.text: New York cannabis sales on pace to shatter last year's record — Sales have topped $1.41 billion through three quarters of 2026, putting the state ahead of 2025's full-year total of $1.68 billion despite signs of a slowdown.

Colorado vape recall draws health complaints — Regulators logged adverse-event reports tied to vaporizers from StayCon (dba Craft) after two consumers reported falling ill; the shop has voluntarily shut down.

MAPS announces psychedelic-therapy training partnership — The nonprofit is teaming with the International Alliance of Psychedelic Therapy Practitioners to expand training standards as the field moves toward FDA approval.

Definium's LSD drug posts second straight Phase 3 win — DT120 (lysergide) met its primary endpoint in the 245-patient Panorama trial for generalized anxiety disorder, teeing up a regulatory submission after a prior trial's success.

Analysts flag cannabis stocks as October buys — Despite rescheduling's delay, coverage points to Innovative Industrial Properties and Trulieve as turnaround plays as the sector's long-term catalysts stay intact.
